profiles.label: Safety control loop
profiles.detail: A machine must stop when a hazardous condition is detected.
profiles.evidence: Keep the decision and actuator path local; send signed events and diagnostics upstream.

profiles.label: Camera safety analytics
profiles.detail: Video frames produce alerts locally while selected evidence reaches the cloud.
profiles.evidence: Run inference at the edge, preserve a bounded local evidence buffer, and coordinate models from the cloud.

profiles.label: Store inventory sync
profiles.detail: Local sales continue during an outage and reconcile with a regional service later.
profiles.evidence: Accept bounded local operations under explicit authority, then reconcile versioned facts after reconnect.

profiles.label: Fleet model training
profiles.detail: Large historical datasets train a model across the fleet rather than on one device.
profiles.evidence: Filter and redact locally, then use elastic regional or cloud compute for training and fleet-wide evaluation.
